title: claude unknown's battle ground
author: zootangerang
selftext: made with opus 5 on claude code, still working on sfx. let me know what yall think!

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
Looks pretty cool. I bet if you iterate some more, Claude can do better houses than this, especially if it focus on them.  
Btw, i noticed your post had 0 upvotes, which is weird because this is clearly a better than average post. Sometimes feels like this sub has haters randomly downvoting stuff lol

replies.author: zootangerang
replies.body: thanks! it's all good, def agree on the houses can look better as well as that water tower

replies.author: EnumeratedArray
replies.body: It shows 0 upvotes because it's a fairly recent post and not got enough votes one way or another. It stops people massively down voting a post just because it is on -2. Reddit does this across the board now

comments.author: OinkLikeAPig
comments.body: Well done. If you go a different kinda style and not copying it, it could be foundation for a great fun arcady game

replies.author: zootangerang
replies.body: thanks! definitely, battle royale games are pretty fun imo
